item.description:
Education

M.Sc. Satellite Technology and Advanced Space Systems, Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg (03/2024 – 09/2026)
Final grade 1.0 (German scale, ≈ 100/100). A competitive program in the Elite Network of Bavaria that combines computer science, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering. Coursework in computer vision, robotics, machine learning and control engineering.

item.title: Projects
item.description:
PRELUDE: satellite project with JAXA

Nihon University, Tokyo (05/2025 – 10/2025)

A joint satellite project with JAXA, carried out during a semester abroad in a CubeSat laboratory. I was responsible for the assembly and verification of a high-frequency plasma measurement instrument (soldering, wiring, bus communication analysis) and led the satellite’s onboard software development for data acquisition and processing, advancing the system from TRL 1 to TRL 5.

item.title: Research
item.description: My research interests are robust visual perception and state estimation for robots in difficult environments, with a focus on space. My current work is on real-time stereo visual odometry for micro aerial vehicles (MAVs).
